business_problem: LaunchDarkly wanted to reduce routine product-management toil and speed up AI-native product delivery, because leaders and teams were spending time on repetitive knowledge work and needed faster ways to test, configure, and ship model-driven software.
solution_summary: LaunchDarkly uses ChatGPT and custom GPTs to remove repetitive product work and align its product-development practices with AI delivery. Claire Vo described building a customer story GPT in minutes so internal teams could self-serve examples instead of routing the same requests through a product executive, while other teams are encouraged to automate similar tasks. The same AI mindset also shapes the product: LaunchDarkly's platform supports day-zero model upgrades so engineering teams can test new machine-learning versions in production, and the company uses AI to simplify multi-step processes, automate configuration, and add natural-language interfaces to products. In practice, knowledge assets and configuration tasks flow into ChatGPT-backed tools, which return reusable answers or streamlined setup steps people can apply immediately. That reduces friction, shortens the path from draft to customer feedback, and helps LaunchDarkly operate like an AI-native technology organization.
